Class StructurePrepareRemoveOwnerEvent

org.bukkit.event.Event

public class StructurePrepareRemoveOwnerEvent extends AnimatedArchitectureSpigotEvent implements IStructurePrepareRemoveOwnerEvent
Represents the event where an owner is removed from a structure.

  • Field Details

    • structure

      protected final Structure structure
      The structure that is targeted by the event.

    • responsible

      protected final Optional<IPlayer> responsible
      The player responsible for the event.

      If the event is caused by a player, such as a player deleting a structure, the responsible player will be set.

      If the event is not caused by a player, this will be empty. This can be the case when a structure is toggled by a redstone signal.
